train_model: run the COPE model training loop with configurable epochs, evaluation splits, and checkpointing
eval_model: evaluate the COPE model on validation, test, or training data splits
display_model_output: interactively display generated model output samples from the validation set
setup_training_environment: initialize logging, distributed training, data loaders, model, and trainer from config
add_train_args_parser: register COPE training CLI arguments including eval, seed, display, and distributed options
